scope: Writing style only: abstracts, introductions, contribution phrasing, result narratives, figures, captions, and concise closing paragraphs. No similarity or novelty assessment.
source_policy: Primary conference proceedings, official program/awards, author-hosted text, public reviews. Citation counts maintained by parent task separately.
limitations: Review score vectors generally unavailable; no inferred mean scores.
Six selected structural readings do not imply every appendix of each long paper was read.
No manuscript modifications and no experimental execution.
